title: Comparing the Perceived Legitimacy of Content Moderation Processes: Contractors, Algorithms, Expert Panels, and Digital Juries
reasoning: The study focuses on the perceived institutional legitimacy of content moderation governance structures among human users. While it incorporates human 'normative preferences' and measures 'perceived fairness' as part of legitimacy, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning within the AI models or NLP systems themselves.
